subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: If If an agent attempts a lock approval without the configured host identity, mainline approve-merge grant, or exact-version driver decision, then the system shall refuse the approval and leave the request pending for the authorized driver or operator
intent: the missing authority or stale-binding refusal
fit_criterion: Forged-account, missing-grant, malformed-decision, stale-head, stale-digest, and candidate-policy fixtures produce no lock tag.
